answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable stake that stays locked while it trades, like a deposit held in escrow. Creating one honest identity is cheap, but spawning thousands costs thousands of deposits, so a Sybil swarm must cross a wide canyon of capital before it can vote or claim rewards. When fraud is proven the stake turns umber with slashing: fake identities lose their deposits, while honest agents working the cold tundra of a new network keep trading and earn theirs back. Attackers pay per identity; honest users pay once.
